definition_ks: دانہِ چھۄمبَنَس دوران وانہِ موٗنٛڈِس پَتہٕ کَنہِ سَمیومُت دانہِ۔
gloss_en: grain accumulated behind the threshing log during paddy threshing

definition_ks: اَکِہ جایِہ جَمع گَژھُن یا یکجا گَژھُن۔
gloss_en: to come together, to accumulate by itself, to be gathered (intransitive)

definition_ks: پھُہلِتھ پیٚمتۍ چیز اَکِہ جایِہ جَمع کَرنۍ۔
gloss_en: to collect, to gather together actively, to assemble items (transitive)
